description: This file defines classes and enums for AES encryption and decryption, including configuration of encryption modes, key management, and initialization vectors within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: AESEncryption
classes.description: Class providing AES encryption functionalities, supporting different modes and key management.

classes.name: AESDecryption
classes.description: Class providing AES decryption functionalities, supporting different modes and key management.

methods.name: InitialVector
methods.description: Gets or sets the initialization vector for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the encryption/decryption key with specified length.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data of specified length.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data of specified length.
